title: Upper bound on dynamic-programming values
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x,s,V,t,c$ be natural-number parameters, with $x$ a finite bit string. The dynamic-programming value at depth $t$ and code $c$ is at most $(2V)^t$.
